slides.copy_text:
Model guide
Small edit or rename -> fast model
Explain a line of code -> fast model
Write a simple test -> fast model
Hard bug with a full error -> strong model
Plan a new feature -> strong model
Fast model failed twice -> switch to the strong model
Always run and test the code yourself.
